note: An inventory of items a producer's file fails to record, per PDF. This does NOT change what the correct answer is — expected.json remains the single statement of that, unmodified. It records that a given input does not contain a usable recording of an item, so the harness does not assert against data that is not there. Every entry needs evidence that can be checked against the file itself.
